verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes an official Agent Toolkit SDK (TypeScript/Python, npm-verified at v1.11.0) with pre-built functions for orders, invoices, subscriptions, refunds, disputes, and catalog management, integrating with major agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, Bedrock, OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, MCP), plus a REST API, sandbox for testing, webhooks, and an official MCP server confirmed live at runtime. missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews/tutorials beyond PayPal's own docs and registry probes.
